headline: Economic exposure is small under marketplace-like baselines (~R$5.4k economic CM negatives; see freight summary for pass-through order negatives). Non-fulfillment-only months are 31% of negative months; the ~95% of negative dollars on those months is mechanical (Returns pool × zero revenue), not an economic finding. Material sales exposure requires thinner margins and/or much higher CTS.
wording_fix: 31% of negative months; ~95% of negative dollars is mechanical Returns-pool allocation
